literature_question: Effect of smooth spatial measurement windows on general backflow

sources.scope: Fine density fringes challenge fluorescence imaging

classical_null: For nonnegative classical joint position-quasimomentum distributions, constant q and v=sin(q), a bounded monotone left weight has Delta<W> <= P(v<0). Positive B_l is sufficient to violate that null.
scope_limit: This is an operational lattice extension of a measurement question, not a continuum bound, experimental implementation, or proof of novelty.

natural_event.comparison: Separate original Gaussian-tail diagnostic; not a resource-matched preparation baseline

sharp_optimized.preparation: incoherent mixture of the same two normalized carrier states

resolution_aware.preparation: incoherent mixture of the same two normalized carrier states

critical_psf_sigma_a.meaning: Zero of the frozen-state, fixed-cut, fixed-time-window witness; not a universal resolution bound

natural_sharp.model: Independent binary PSF-threshold counts at t1,t2 plus velocity-sign counts

natural_half_site.model: Independent binary PSF-threshold counts at t1,t2 plus velocity-sign counts

prepared_half_site.model: Independent binary PSF-threshold counts at t1,t2 plus velocity-sign counts

projection_control_note: Hard positive-velocity projection changes the spatial budget and creates long tails. Its finite-periodic DFT result is a diagnostic only and is not ranked as an equal-resource preparation. Principal results use unprojected localized states and continuous Bloch integrals.
sampling_noise_model: Five-sigma normal-approximation estimate for independent measurements at t1 and t2; separately report ideal exact-position W-weighted variance and actual blurred binary-threshold variance p(1-p). A third independent velocity-sign ensemble estimates P(v<0). M is shots per ensemble, not total shots or camera photons; technical noise and PSF calibration uncertainty are omitted.
not_tested: Antenna drive or coherent preparation energy
Detector imperfections beyond a known Gaussian PSF
Loss, dephasing, interactions, and material-specific spin readout
